fusionGroups.description:
Each fusion group contains a list of vertices that should be fused together, the runtime the fused group should
execute in, and the hardware constraint for the fused group execution.

title:
The {@link Workflow.VertexFusion} optimization merges a set of {@link Workflow.Vertex} into a single {@link Workflow.Action}
vertex, to be executed in a single process. For example, this could reduce network, scheduling, data movement overhead
for a series of simple actions.
There are numerous factors to take into account when deciding whether to fuse a set of vertices:
- similarity (or equality) of {@link ImplLanguage.Runtime} of proposed vertices
- aggregated {@link ResourceProfile} of proposed vertices, after fusion
- special/expensive (e.g. GPU) resource requirements that may not be required for all proposed vertices
- parallelization vs fusion tradeoff for proposed vertices that run in parallel
name: Workflow.VertexFusion
